output_list.criticism: The functions mint and mintCoins are vulnerable to integer overflow attacks. Both functions calculate the amount of tokens to mint by multiplying the amount of ETH sent by the price of the current stage. The price is stored in a uint128 variable, which can overflow when the amount of ETH sent is very large. The overflow can cause the functions to mint more tokens than the maximum supply of the token.

The function GetStats is vulnerable to integer overflow attacks. It calculates the time to end of the current stage by subtracting the current time from the start time of the stage. The start time is stored in a uint256 variable, which can overflow when the current time is very large. The overflow can cause the function to return incorrect time to end.
